title: AI Factory Swarm migration profile
description: `.migration/profile.yaml` in the target repo: everything stack-specific for one migration (architecture §7).

path.description: Folder inside the source repo that holds the application.

encoding.description: Source file encoding (spike M1-5: legacy code may not be UTF-8).

characterization.description: Default characterization tier (ADR-0005); capabilities may override it in the ledger.

patches.description: Files under the harness patches/ folder applied after install.

enrich.description: ADR-0020: harness enrichers (tools/enrich_graph.py) run on each side's graph after Understand Anything, adding the tables, endpoints, pages, routes and data links it cannot infer. Values come from the stack pack's `graph` block.

require.description: ADR-0020: node and edge types each side's (enriched) graph must contain; tools/graph_gate.py fails without them.

target_paths.description: Target folders the target graph analyses; check_graph_fresh compares their git tree hashes (ADR-0019). Keep tests out, so test-only changes don't make the graph stale.

target_exclude.description: Folders of the target repo that hold no application pages (e.g. tooling, characterization harnesses). check_graph_fresh skips their templates when it checks that target_paths covers every page (ADR-0023). .github, .migration, .source, docs, tests and node_modules are always skipped.

exclude.description: Globs for vendored, minified and generated code (ADR-0013).

skills.description: Stack-specific skills by capability. The built-in menu (skills.lock.json) is always installed.

gates.description: Commands per gate (architecture §10.3). `{changed}` is replaced by the changed files.

context.description: ADR-0015 budgets, as a share of the model's context window.

snapshot.description: ADR-0032: commands that make the snapshot in {out} (export + manifest), run by the AFS data snapshot workflow when the snapshot owner dispatches it.

snapshot_java.description: ADR-0032: Java version the snapshot workflow installs (setup-java, temurin), e.g. for a legacy runtime or the JDBC exporter.

snapshot_dir.description: ADR-0032: where the operator puts the legacy snapshot (one CSV per table + manifest.json). Gitignored: production data is never committed.

mapping.description: ADR-0032: source → target tables, columns, transforms and references; the loader and data_reconcile.py both read it.

load.description: ADR-0032: commands that load {snapshot} into the target through the pipeline (idempotent).

export.description: ADR-0032: commands that write the target's mapped tables as <table>.csv (header row, NULL as \N) into {out}, for data_reconcile.py.

services.description: The target's Docker Compose file is the one definition of the real services tests run against (database, broker, external-system stand-ins). Copilot setup steps and the CI gates start services.test with tools/afs-services; the human runs the same file locally. Required when target.stacks.data is set.

compose.description: Path from the target repo root, e.g. compose.yaml.

test.description: Compose services the tests need; each defines a healthcheck.

env.description: Optional variables exported to later steps so tests reach the services.

signoff.description: ADR-0031: who may sign off a slice's human side-by-side check. The sign-off is an approving review by one of these logins on the PR that sets human_check: passed (tools/check_signoff.py).

costs.description: ADR-0021: where billed Copilot AI credits and Actions minutes are read from (tools/afs-costs, AFS costs workflow).

account.description: User login, organization or enterprise slug that pays for Copilot.
